cues: But how he set, I know not.
Eight lines of confident telling, and now, I know not.
Notice the sun has become he: a person, with a will, gone somewhere she cannot follow.
And everything is hedged: there seemed a purple stile.
A stile is a set of steps built over a field wall, so people can cross where animals cannot.
The horizon at evening becomes a boundary, with a way over it.
